name: Too Lewd!
source:
Fresh from the Fey-realm, Luna is ecstatic to be offered a quest on her very first day in the modern world. She's going to be Blue Bells' new village bicycle! Sure, it doesn't sound all that fancy, but the recruiter said she'd be giving everyone "Happy Endings"… and as one of the Fair-Folk, what could possibly be better?

Well… it might be nice if her new town wasn't home to a celibacy cult with building sexual frustrations threatening to awaken a slumbering eldritch Goddess... But the Fair-Folk keep their word!

Help Luna make new friends, overcome her inhibitions and have sex with absolutely everyone before time runs out and the world is plunged into madness and despair!

[From [url=https://heedless.itch.io/too-lewd/]Itch[/url]]
translation:
刚离开妖精界的露娜，在来到现代世界的第一天便接到任务，兴奋不已。她要成为蓝铃镇新任的“人人都能骑的自行车”！听起来确实不怎么体面，可招募她的人说，她能给所有人带来“快乐结局”……身为妖精，还有什么比这更美好的呢？

嗯……如果新住处没有一个禁欲教派就好了。信徒们不断积压的性压抑，正威胁着要唤醒一位沉睡的远古邪神……可妖精一族向来言出必行！

帮助露娜结交新朋友、放下拘束，在时间耗尽、世界坠入疯狂与绝望之前，与所有人发生性关系吧！

[摘自[url=https://heedless.itch.io/too-lewd/]Itch[/url]]
